description: A language's own evaluator reached by caller-supplied data. The policy that finds this was written for operating-system shells and was not touched to cover it — the channel description carries the weakness identity, so the same judgement produces CWE-95 here and CWE-78 for a shell. The third route interpolates untrusted data into a string and is not a finding: a template is data, and only a destination that INTERPRETS its input is a channel.

expected.note: eval() compiles and runs its argument
the Function constructor is an evaluator by another name
